title.zh: Google Built an AI That Hunts Its Own Security Bugs
title.en: Google Built an AI That Hunts Its Own Security Bugs

current_state.zh: Google disclosed PageBreak, an internal AI agent that has autonomously uncovered more than 500 confirmed exploitable security bugs in its own web applications with near-zero false positives, and plans to combine it with its CodeMender automated bug-fixing agent.
current_state.en: Google disclosed PageBreak, an internal AI agent that has autonomously uncovered more than 500 confirmed exploitable security bugs in its own web applications with near-zero false positives, and plans to combine it with its CodeMender automated bug-fixing agent.
